summary: Connect to an existing AdGuard Home instance for read-only status without changing its configuration or ownership.

inputs.description: An explicitly approved IP-literal AdGuard Home origin.

privileges.description: An existing instance may require a credential to read its API.

dependencies.description: A separately operated AdGuard Home instance at the approved origin.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: Approved HTTPS IP-literal origin, or loopback HTTP origin.

fields.name: credential_ref
fields.description: Controller-owned Keychain reference; no password is stored in configuration.

provenance.version_policy: The external owner chooses the installed version; Cozy SOC accepts only the tested v0.107.79 API.

data_handling.activation: Connection setup reads service state after deliberate approval. A separate exact-scope terminal approval reads up to 100 recent queries once; there is no background polling or external settings change.
sources: Approved external AdGuard Home status, filtering and query-log configuration GET endpoints.
Separately approved bounded query-log GET for the selected enrolled network scope.
stored: External ownership, approved origin, credential reference and control audit records.
Scoped client-IP DNS observations with ephemeral 24-hour retention and content-free collection audits after separate approval.
excluded: Credentials in config or diagnostics, DNS query history during setup, unmatched or anonymized clients, and all external service configuration changes.
